title: Circle and Rectangle Overlapping
description: Check if a circle overlaps with an axis-aligned rectangle by finding the closest point on the rectangle to the circle center.
pseudocode:
1. closestX = max(x1, min(xCenter, x2))
2. closestY = max(y1, min(yCenter, y2))
3. distanceX = xCenter - closestX
4. distanceY = yCenter - closestY
5. return (distanceX^2 + distanceY^2) <= radius^2

steps.note: Find the closest X coordinate on the rectangle to the circle center x=0. Clamp 0 between [1, 3].
Find the closest Y coordinate on the rectangle to the circle center y=0. Clamp 0 between [-1, 1].
Check squared distance (-1)^2 + 0^2 = 1. Since 1 <= 1^2, return true.
